articles.title: Flash flood on Nepal-Tibet border kills more than 150, with hundreds of tourists missing - BBC
articles.description: Nepal's tourist board says the missing tourists include 133 from India, 54 from the US, and 33 from the UK, as well as more than 100 from Nepal itself.
